reviewed_by: Codex: manual retail Radare2 instruction versus candidate x86-source review, 2026-10-19

checks.name: function_identity
checks.rationale: Reviewed retail instructions 0x004AF8F0..0x004AF90B with Radare2; existing Binary Ninja and Radare2 records identify the same straight-line entry.

checks.name: argument_mapping
checks.rationale: Retail loads context from esp+4 into eax and node from esp+8 into ecx; PE32 wrapper passes two x86 cdecl pointers.

checks.name: constants_and_scaling
checks.rationale: Offsets +4 and +8 represent four-byte x86 pointer fields. No numeric scaling.

checks.name: memory_layout_and_access
checks.rationale: The x86 branch reads header+8, writes node+4, writes node+0 with header+4, writes through the old tail and writes header+8. Compared all 12 header bytes and all 8 bytes of each node across 12 layouts.

checks.name: calls_and_side_effects
checks.rationale: Retail body contains no calls. Candidate x86 splice and return match retail memory and eax in all twelve cases.

checks.name: return_and_error_paths
checks.rationale: Retail returns original context in eax without null checks. Review covers valid, non-aliasing writable list/node fixtures only; invalid-pointer faults and concurrency are excluded.

checks.name: floating_point_semantics
checks.rationale: No floating-point instructions or values occur in this body.

limitations: Only Windows x86 branch is reviewed; host 64-bit compatibility branch is excluded.
angr/VEX executes concrete fixtures, not an original-game runtime capture or universal equivalence proof.
No independent second reviewer was available in this pass; status remains STRUCTURALLY_VERIFIED.
